title: Why women sang the blues more than men; B.B. King
summary: She says women feel the blues harder than men, who turn to gambling and drink, and that men are returning to the blues.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the blues is, and why every jazz player needs it
